title: Crimson Skies, GTA San Andreas, MechAssault 2 (three soak titles; see runs)

arms.A: f82e7e87fe, --env PERF_REGIMEN=max: performance_mode 2 before `am start`. On the Thor MAX's fan mode is 4 (SMART), the same as the defaults' (perf_regimen.json of 0-0-x-1790557233-hostops-810152: max = perf 2 / fan 4, rest = perf 0 / fan 4), so on this device the arms differ in performance_mode only.
arms.B: f82e7e87fe, the same apk, --env PERF_REGIMEN=default: performance_mode 0, fan_mode 4 (SMART), the device's own defaults (#533). The regimen is the only independent variable.

runs: Thor only, priority 1 (HAKUX_RELEASE_PRIO=1), one pair per title, each run from a cool start through soak_title.sh's cool-down gate (#519). Crimson Skies - High Road to Revenge (USA) (En,Fr,De,Zh,Ko).xiso.iso, route crimson-skies, 1950 s, order A then B. 54540082-Grand_Theft_Auto_San_Andreas.xiso.iso, route gta-sa, 2100 s, order B then A. 4D53006B-MechAssault_2_Lone_Wolf.xiso.iso, route mechassault-2, 2100 s, order A then B. The seconds are 1800 s after `mark gameplay` plus the lead to the mark on disk (Crimson ~105 s: 0-0-x-1790549042-flip474-1819312; GTA ~220 s: 0-0-x-1790533127-gta482-3508140; MechAssault 2 ~255 s: 0-0-x-1790557233-hostops-810152) plus ~45 s of slack. REPEAT RULE, fixed now: a pair is run once more, in the reverse order, when its fps difference or its power cut is within noise: |median fps A - median fps B| <= 1.0 fps, or |cut_w| <= 0.3 W (cut_w as in P1). The verdict then reads the median of the two pairs' values per leg. PILOT (not scored): one 450 s GTA run at B, which checks the regimen read-back, the gate, the mark and the power fields before 6 x ~35 min of device time is queued.
reader: python3 docs/lanes/sustain507/regimen_read.py <runs> (per-run table) and python3 docs/lanes/sustain507/regimen_read.py --pair <A run> <B run> (P1), at the commit that adds this file. Window: `mark gameplay` to +1800 s, cut at `soak end`. fps = 60 / dt between consecutive hakuX-perf lines (title_verdict.py's measure), time-weighted median and p10. NOT voided after a MAX pause: the reader reports the whole window, the clean span before the first pause, and the span after it, each labelled. stability = median fps in minutes 20-30 / median fps in minutes 2-10, from the mark. Mitigation = the first sample in which any cooling device's cur_state rises above its `start` value (panel backlights excluded); pause = thermal_state.first_pause(); both as after/by bounds, from the run's start. Power from thermal_state.power_over(): net_w = battery_w + usb_w; j_per_frame = net_w x scored seconds / flips. Plateau = the first sample after which xo-therm stays within 1.5 C of its median over the window's last 300 s.

legs.L0 (instrument; a run failing it is VOID: perf_regimen.json reads regimen max with perf_mode 2 on A, and regimen default with perf_mode 0 and fan_mode 4 on B; `mark gameplay` present; the window is >= 1740 s; thermal.jsonl readable over the window with no gap over 90 s (thermal_state.coverage is None); power measured with sign_suspect 0; the COOLDOWN line shows xo-therm under 65 C at the start. FAILS in a world where the dispatcher does not pass PERF_REGIMEN through (B reads perf_mode 2), the route loses gameplay, or the sampler stops.
legs.P1 (defaults draw less): Per title, cut_w = net_w(A) - net_w(B) over the SAME span [mark, mark + S], S = A's clean span (its first pause's `after` bound from the mark, or 1800 s with no pause; under 120 s the title is unreadable for P1). PASS: the median cut over the three titles lies in [0.5, 1.5] W and no title's cut is under 0.3 W. REFUTED if the median cut is under 0.5 W: the Thor's performance_mode 2 then raises floors that the governor already reaches under this load, and MAX costs nothing in watts. Also refuted, in the other direction, if the median cut is over 1.5 W: the review's range is too low. The whole-window net_w is reported beside it, and is not the leg, because a MAX pause lowers MAX's draw.
legs.P2 (content-capped titles lose no fps: C: Crimson is paced to 30 by the game. MechAssault 2 read 30.0 median and 30.0 p10 over 24 min at MAX with no pause on disk (0-0-x-1790557233-hostops-810152), so it is treated as capped too. PASS per title: B's median fps over the window >= A's median fps over A's clean span - 1.0, and B's p10 >= A's clean-span p10 - 1.0. REFUTED for a title if B's median is more than 1.0 fps below A's: then MAX bought frames on that title at defaults and it is not content-capped on the Thor at defaults.
legs.P3 (GTA SA: MAX collapses, defaults do n: (a) A pauses inside its window (pause `by` <= the mark + 1800 s), and A's median fps after the pause is <= 1/3 of its clean-span median (the 5-7x collapse, with margin). (b) B has no pause from its start through the window's end, and B's stability >= 0.90. (c) B's median over minutes 20-30 > A's median over minutes 20-30. REFUTED if B pauses inside 30 minutes (GTA then fails sustained at the defaults, and the defaults avoid nothing), or B's stability is under 0.90 (a slower slide under another mitigation). If A does not pause inside its window, (a) and (c) are INERT, not failed: the collapse was not provoked, and the leg says so. Early fps: B's minutes 2-10 median may be under A's. That is reported, and it is not a leg.
legs.M (measured, not predicted): Per run: fps median and p10, stability, seconds to the first mitigation event and to the first pause, max xo-therm, net_w, j_per_frame, battery hours at net_w. At B, the minute at which xo-therm plateaus. The confirmation length follows from the latest B plateau: proposed = that minute + 10 min of plateau, rounded up to 5 min, reported on #507 for the owner.

battery_capacity: Not assumed. The thermal samples carry capacity % but not charge_full. regimen_read.py pools the battery's energy (the integral of battery_w) over the capacity it cost across all runs, and prints the range the 1 % steps allow. On the one run tried (hostops-810152: 1.27 Wh for 1 %) that gives an implausible 64-127 Wh, so the hours column is reported only if the pooled range is narrow (max/min <= 1.3); otherwise it stays blank until charge_full is read off the Thor.
what_this_cannot_see: One pair per title, one device, one ambient (not recorded), the Thor charging at ~2.1 W from its 500 mA port throughout. Battery level and start temperature differ between runs within the gate's limit; both are reported per run. A cut from performance_mode alone: on the Nova MAX also changes the fan mode, and nothing here speaks for the Nova.
expect_note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE: a soak writes no captures, so there is no golden key. The legs are read with regimen_read.py off logcat.txt, thermal.jsonl and perf_regimen.json. arms.sh skips soak predictions (title set); this lane queues them with request.sh.
